summary: Iteration 30 — validated the four batch features: (2) Weekly Walkaround mid-week start (no Monday snap), (3) VOR button on Vehicles + calendar events, (5) Viewer (read-only) TM role via Team invite with server-enforced 403, and the new Repairs / Major Work CRUD. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter30_viewer_vor_repairs_weekly.py: 15/15 PASSED. Frontend UI smoke: manager login → Team page role-manager/role-viewer/invite-email-input/send-invite-button all render; Vehicles page mounts (fixed a critical compile-breaking syntax error, see below) with vor-button/clear-vor-button, VOR dialog exposes vor-reason/vor-off-date/vor-return-date/save-vor-button; Maintenance tabs tab-weekly & tab-repairs present, repairs-page + add-repair-button OK, weekly editor exposes weekly-week (any-day date input) and manager sees NO viewer-banner. Viewer end-to-end flow: invited via /api/invitations {role:'viewer'}, accepted via /api/auth/accept-invite, logged in in real browser → viewer-banner text 'Read-only access. You can view everything but changes are disabled.' displayed, viewer sees inviter's vehicle in Fleet, POST /api/vehicles from viewer's token returns HTTP 403 (verified in-browser via fetch). All backend viewer-write blocks confirmed: POST/PUT/DELETE /api/vehicles = 403, POST /api/repairs = 403, POST /api/weekly-walkarounds = 403, POST /api/vehicles/{id}/vor = 403; manager (non-viewer) writes NOT blocked. Weekly mid-week: POST /api/weekly-walkarounds with week_start=2026-06-16 (Tue) and 2026-08-13 (Thu) both preserve the exact date (no Monday snap); PDF still generates (%PDF header). VOR endpoint: POST /api/vehicles/{id}/vor sets vor=true + vor_reason, creates 2 calendar_events (off-road + expected-back) surfaced by GET /api/calendar as titles 'VOR — <reg> off road' and 'VOR — <reg> expected back in service'; /vor/clear resets flag and deletes the 2 events. Repairs full CRUD via /api/repairs works with fields vehicle_reg/category/description/provider/cost.

minor.issue: Endpoint strips the internal 'ref' field when projecting calendar_events into the response. Not a bug — but any UI wanting to filter events by their source (e.g. only VOR events) has to match on title prefix. Consider exposing 'ref' or a 'source' key so the frontend / integrations can reliably distinguish system-generated events from user-created ones.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL compile error found and fixed by test agent: file had `}` closing VehiclesPanel at line 196 followed by an orphan `return (` at line 197 — the outer `export default function Vehicles()` declaration was missing. Whole app rendered a red 'Compiled with problems: Module build failed … return outside of function' overlay and login was impossible. Fixed by inserting `export default function Vehicles() {` on line 197. Please review — this suggests the batch merge dropped the outer component signature.

action_items: Review the Vehicles.js patch (added `export default function Vehicles() {` on line 197) and ensure no other pages have a similarly-orphaned outer wrapper after the batch merge.
(Optional) Expose 'ref'/'source' on GET /api/calendar responses so the frontend can distinguish VOR-generated events from user-added ones for filtering, deletion guards, etc.

server.py:914 get_current_user overrides user_id -> account_owner_id for viewers so all list/read queries return the inviter's data. Confirmed: viewer GET /api/vehicles returns owner's records.

server.py:739 weekly_columns() rotates (weekday_key, iso_date) tuples starting from week_start — good; keeps DB days keyed by 'mon'..'sun' but presents rotated columns to UI/PDF.
server.py:3601 set_vehicle_vor / 3622 clear_vehicle_vor — both correctly delete_many({'ref':f'vor:{vid}'}) before re-insert, so re-marking is idempotent.
